items.q: Chief was with Louie after he left me

items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: They seen me up there with Ernie Fields, they'd point at me or they whisper among themselves that I was in there playing with the black men.

ctx.x: Didn't they call that sweet music sometimes?

Yeah, yeah, right. There used to be a place called -- a tearoom, gypsy tearoom, Little Old Gypsy Tearoom where all the bands played and the visiting bands that would come through like the Carolina Cotton Pickers and Hartley Toots from Miami and Ernie Fields would come in there, too. It was only a few years later that I joined Ernie in New York. And territory bands that'd come through, all girl bands, the bands from Mississippi, from Piney Woods, Sweethearts of Rhythm, that's the name of the band.
Sweethearts of Rhythm -- all girls, yeah.
